verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a cloud GPU and ML platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Paperspace publishing its platform, CLI or SDK source under an open license. The published OpenAPI spec and API reference are interface documentation, not source code under an open license, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
